narr: Heavy rain fell on May 31st leading to flash flooding in Miami and Leavenworth Counties.
ev: KOFO reported a car with water up to the door required a water rescue. This was an isolated report.
Water was along the road at 219th and 211th Streets.
lsr: KOFO REPORTED A CAR WITH WATER UP TO THE DOOR REQUIRING A WATER RESCUE.
Water over road ways along 219th and 211th Streets north of Fairmount Rd.
